title: Indigenous Culture & History Tour from Calgary to Siksika Nation
requirements: Infants are required to sit on an adult’s lap
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Explore the rich Indigenous history and culture of the Blackfoot people on this guided tour from Calgary to First Nation land. This significant site marks the location where one of the first historic agreements between the First Nations and European representatives was signed.

Engage with informative exhibits, traverse the scenic landscapes, and gain insights into the legacy of Canada's residential schools through respectful storytelling. This educational tour focuses on fostering understanding and reconciliation, making it ideal for those passionate about Indigenous culture and Canadian history. 

- 4 to 5-hour guided tour from Calgary to Blackfoot Crossing Historical Park 

- Explore Blackfoot history, Treaty 7, and traditional culture 

- Visit the Blackfoot Crossing Museum and Tipi Village for an authentic experience 

- Ideal for travelers interested in Indigenous culture, education, and local experiences
